name: Robo Otto!
source:
Have you ever wished you could enjoy a robot's companionship?

Bond with the three robots, as you test their ability to be humanity's companions. Maybe you will even find love in the process...?

Or not!

[From [url=https://lil-beastman.itch.io/robo-otto]Itch.io[/url]]
